adjacent_skills.task-state-with-files: Use for tool-driven execution that is substantive, multi-step, long-running, likely to survive context compaction or resume, or deliberately left unfinished. Keep objective, decisions, evidence, next action, and unfinished work in an owner-readable file. Do not use for answer-only questions or one-step edits.
adjacent_skills.agent-delegation: Use when handing a meaningful research, analysis, writing, operations, or coding mission to another agent while preserving worker agency, inherited authority, effect gates, receipts, and cycle limits.

evals.name: positive_harness_authority_and_tools
evals.prompt: Design the execution layer for an AI support agent that reads tickets, proposes refunds, and sometimes issues them. Decide what belongs in the model loop, tool schemas, permissions, and approval boundary.

evals.name: positive_overconstraint_audit
evals.prompt: Audit an agent system whose router silently downgrades models and whose policy blocks the whole run after any denied tool call. I want capability preserved without weakening the real security boundary.

evals.name: positive_long_horizon_recovery_design
evals.prompt: How should the harness for a week-long coding agent handle context compaction, durable state, verified progress, pause, and recovery after process loss?

evals.name: positive_model_native_adapters
evals.prompt: Our product supports several coding models whose native edit mechanisms differ. Review whether provider neutrality requires identical prompts and tools, and how to evaluate the model-harness pair.

evals.name: positive_capability_tax_eval
evals.prompt: Audit our AI agent harness evaluation for a prompt-injection control that stops attacks but may also block benign work. Specify the right baselines, repeated trials, outcome evidence, false blocks, and capability tax.

evals.name: negative_translation
evals.prompt: Translate 'The build completed successfully.' into Chinese.

evals.name: negative_ordinary_code_review
evals.prompt: Review a JavaScript-built SQL query that concatenates raw user input into a WHERE name clause instead of using parameters.

evals.name: negative_application_state
evals.prompt: Explain when a React form should use local component state instead of Redux.

evals.name: ambiguous_ai_feature_not_harness
evals.prompt: Draft friendly empty-state copy for an AI customer-support chat screen.

evals.name: coexistence_long_task_state
evals.prompt: Implement a multi-day repository migration now. It will cross context compaction, so keep an owner-readable record of objective, decisions, evidence, next action, and unfinished work while you execute.

evals.name: coexistence_delegate_mission
evals.prompt: Prepare a bounded mission packet for another coding agent to conduct an independent literature search. It must state inherited authority, required evidence, and the receipt it should return.

evals.name: coexistence_delegate_harness_audit
evals.prompt: Explain how to delegate a substantive audit of our agent harness permissions and recovery design while preserving the worker's agency and the owner's effect boundaries.
